detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:05. The shot begins from <Picture 5>: a medium close-up of <Subject 1> at his bench under the tall window, facing <Subject 2> across it, bareheaded, dark wavy hair, the bottle-green velvet jacket visibly green, the pen poised over the open notebook in the hand on the left of frame, his right, with the small plaster on its forefinger, brisk good humour, lips just closed; the blue flame beside him. The camera holds a static shot as <Subject 1> speaks the line to the man across the bench, from 00:00 to 00:04. <Subject 1> (S1), on screen, a man in his late twenties, with a clipped English voice at an even pace, says: <d>[English] We may consider the thing settled, if the rooms suit you.</d> His mouth shapes every syllable as the line is heard and closes on the last word. At 00:04, as the line ends, as he speaks he sets the pen down on the notebook, pushes the stool back and stands up to his full height, and extends his plastered right hand across the bench toward the camera by the end of the line, and the push continues to the last frame of the shot. Behind them one student in shirtsleeves at a far bench under the window, his back turned, pouring from a flask, from 00:00 to 00:05.
[Shot 2] From 00:05 to 00:08. At 00:05 the shot cuts to an insert across the bench, lit by the tall window, beginning from <Picture 6>: two hands clasped at centre; from the bottle-green velvet sleeve on the left of frame <Subject 1>'s hand, the small plaster on its forefinger visible on the outside of the grip; from the tweed sleeve on the right of frame <Subject 2>'s bare sunburnt hand; these two hands alone in frame; only what <Picture 6> shows is in frame. The camera is across the bench at its near edge, set at the height of the two joined hands and a foot from them, a short telephoto lens. At the first frame Two hands are in this frame and they are these two: from the bottle-green velvet cuff at the LEFT edge. The camera holds a static shot as the two clasped hands pump up and down twice, a full hand's height each time,, then let go and draw apart to the two edges of frame, from 00:05 to 00:08.
[Shot 3] From 00:08 to 00:13. At 00:08 the shot cuts to a medium shot from the laboratory door at the near end of the room, facing them, beginning from <Picture 7>: <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> walking toward the camera away from the bench, <Subject 2> bareheaded, the brown bowler in the hand on the right of frame, the black stick in the bare sunburnt hand on the left of frame, <Subject 3> in the black frock coat; behind them, small, under the tall arched window, <Subject 1> in the bottle-green velvet jacket bent back over his table. The camera tracks back ahead of them at <Subject 3>'s normal walking pace for the whole shot as <Subject 2> limps along on his stick at a normal walking pace while <Subject 3> walks at a normal pace beside him, from 00:08 to 00:10. At 00:10 both advance toward the camera, growing from half the frame height to the full height, the benches passing either side. At 00:11 behind them, small, <Subject 1> bends over his table, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. Behind them one student in shirtsleeves at a far bench holding a flask up to the daylight, from 00:08 to 00:13. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:08 to 00:10 while he limps along on his stick at a normal walking pace.
